summary: Vaxart, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 19, 2026, disclosing a letter to shareholders urging support for its six director nominees at the upcoming Annual Meeting (July 16, 2026), in response to a shareholder's nomination of three dissident director candidates. No deal terms are stated. The board recommends supporting its nominees; advisors are not named. Structurally, the proxy contest involves Vaxart opposing an activist campaign. The outcome hinges on shareholder votes at the Annual Meeting; watch for proxy advisor recommendations and vote tallies as key risk factors.
